items.title: GUI-heavy contracts have no accessibility or localization oracle
items.statement: Across authentication, disabled controls, identity disclosure, confirmation, runtime controls, warnings, raw XML editing, and status rows, no acceptance criterion covers keyboard/focus order, screen-reader names and live updates, non-color state cues, zoom/reflow, reduced motion, localized expansion, or whether preserved exact English phrases are semantic message keys versus hard-coded copy.
items.impact: A visually correct implementation can remain unusable with assistive technology or fail under localized text expansion while still satisfying every listed acceptance criterion.
items.builder_discretion: Implementation technique is open; accessibility and localization acceptance behavior is not optional.

evidence.exact_quote: Disabled controls remain explainable with exact blocking condition, missing capability, degraded reason, reason code, last validation time, and primary recovery CTA when one exists.
Docker Manager uses the exact grammar Requested account, Requested binding, Effective account, and Switch reason.
Unknown or unmodeled content remains editable through raw XML and saves preserve unmodified passthrough content verbatim.

synthesis.summary: The macro has strong separation of remote side effects, explicit receipt/blocked-state joins, durable runtime identity, protected DockerHub repository creation, no-silent-rebind stream behavior, untrusted-state disclosure, and XML passthrough preservation. It is not implementation-closed: two critical contradictions/safety defects and twenty-one high-severity gaps remain, concentrated in detection truth, execution-time approval freshness, placeholder operation anchors, publish idempotency, tag identity, path/XML safety, review/commit state, Git index containment, and template-repo remote effects.
highest_priority_resolution_order: Resolve needs_review auto-commit contradiction and derive all review gates from one required-field registry.
Make auto-commit index-safe and path-contained, including staged content and symlinks.
Unify broad project detection and close approval-snapshot TOCTOU.
Replace CRAU-041 placeholders with typed commands, states, callers, consumers, and oracles.
Define idempotent publish/repo workflows, canonical tag/digest identity, and indeterminate remote recovery.
Specify safe XML parsing, atomic saves, secret non-persistence, and generated-path containment.
explicit_strengths: Remote build, image push, repository creation, and template push are conceptually distinct effects.
Blocked, failed, degraded, historical, and indeterminate concepts are not intentionally flattened.
Unknown XML content is protected from silent deletion.
Cross-surface owner and event-registration boundaries are explicit.
Local artifacts and completed builds survive several remote-side failure paths.
synthesis.builder_discretion_boundary: Builders may choose internal libraries, visual composition, bounded retry timing, and normalized data structures only where exact contracts are already present. They must not invent resolutions for the listed contradictions, authority gaps, state precedence, path/secret safety, event/operation schemas, or remote-effect protocols.
